title: Explore Local Statistics internal API
description: Read-only statistical, metadata and geographic operations documented by the Explore Local Statistics application wiki.

policy.intendedAudience: ONS applications and approved internal use
policy.warning: The upstream wiki says this API is internal/private, is not intended for non-ONS web applications, may change without notice, and prevents cross-origin browser requests.

topic.description: One or more comma-separated topic or sub-topic codes, or all.

indicator.description: One or more comma-separated indicator slugs, or all.

excludeMultivariate.description: Exclude multivariate indicators unless explicitly selected.

time.description: latest, earliest, all, one date, or a comma-separated inclusive range.

timeNearest.description: Fallback behaviour when the selected date is outside an indicator's range.

geo.description: One or more comma-separated geography-level keys or GSS codes.

geoExtent.description: Parent GSS code used to constrain returned geographies.

hasGeo.description: Return indicators that include a geography level or GSS code.

dimension_{code}.description: Dynamic non-time, non-geography dimension filter. Replace {code} with an indicator dimension code.

measure.description: One or more measures. The wiki lists this parameter but does not define its semantics.

includeNames.description: Include human-readable area names where supported.

includeStatus.description: Include observation-level status identifiers where available.

year.description: Geography validity year or all/latest where supported.

country.description: One or more of E, N, S or W, or all.

geoLevel.description: One or more geography-level keys, such as ltla or rgn.

asLookup.description: Return an object keyed by identifier instead of an array.

groupByLevel.description: Group returned areas by geography level.

includeDates.description: Include area start and end dates.

includeAreas.description: Include the individual area codes at each level.

parentLevel.description: Parent geography level within which siblings are selected.

searchPostcodes.description: Fall back to postcode results when no area name matches.

hasYear.description: Return indicators that contain the specified YYYY year.

flat.description: Return a flattened taxonomy instead of nested topics.

operations.title: Filter and download statistical data
operations.summary: Filter one or more indicators by topic, geography, time, dimensions and measures.

defaults.includeStatus: true for json and xlsx; false otherwise

operations.title: List geographic areas
operations.summary: List names, codes and selected metadata for geographies represented in ELS.

operations.title: List geography levels
operations.summary: List geography-level keys, type prefixes and optionally their area codes.

operations.title: Look up one geographic area
operations.summary: Return a GeoJSON feature with boundary geometry and extended metadata for a GSS code.

operations.title: List all related areas
operations.summary: Return parents, children, siblings and statistically similar areas.

operations.title: List parent areas
operations.summary: List parents for an area identified by GSS code.

operations.title: List child areas
operations.summary: List immediate children or children at a selected geography level.

operations.title: List sibling areas
operations.summary: List siblings sharing an immediate or selected parent level.

operations.title: List statistically similar areas
operations.summary: List cluster members and the 20 most similar areas for supported groupings.

operations.title: Get generalised boundaries
operations.summary: Return filtered, low-resolution boundaries as GeoJSON or TopoJSON.

operations.title: Search areas by name
operations.summary: Search area names and optionally fall back to postcode autocomplete.

operations.title: Reverse geographic lookup
operations.summary: Return areas containing a longitude and latitude.

operations.title: Look up a full postcode
operations.summary: Return public postcode coordinates and containing geographies.
operations.privacyNote: The operation is public lookup metadata. The OKF bundle stores neither submitted postcodes nor returned coordinates.

operations.title: Autocomplete a partial postcode
operations.summary: Return matching postcodes and public coordinates for a partial postcode.
operations.privacyNote: The OKF bundle stores neither submitted postcode fragments nor returned postcodes or coordinates.

operations.title: List indicator metadata
operations.summary: Return metadata for indicators filtered by topic, geography and year.

operations.title: Get one indicator's metadata
operations.summary: Return metadata for one indicator and optionally its full dimension values.

operations.title: List values for one indicator dimension
operations.summary: Return possible values for a specific dimension of a specific indicator.

operations.title: List the indicator taxonomy
operations.summary: Return indicators grouped into topics and sub-topics, nested or flat.

issues.title: The API is internal/private and unstable
issues.statement: The bundle must not imply that the API is public, supported for third parties, stable, or usable cross-origin from browsers.
issues.recommendation: Keep execution opt-in and obtain an ONS-supported contract before depending on the service.

issues.title: Dimension-values route differs
issues.statement: Following the documented route can address the wrong optional-rest route instead of the dimension handler.
issues.recommendation: Update the wiki or implementation and add a route contract test.

issues.title: Area-name parameter name and default conflict
issues.wikiEvidence: The parameter table and example use includeNames with default true; prose says names are excluded by default and refers to geoNames.
issues.sourceEvidence: The data handler accepts includeNames and defaults it to true.
issues.statement: Clients following the prose can send an invalid parameter or assume the wrong payload shape.
issues.recommendation: Use includeNames consistently and state one tested default.

issues.title: includeDates is documented where handlers reject it
issues.wikiEvidence: Name search, reverse lookup and postcode lookup parameter tables list includeDates.
issues.sourceEvidence: The reviewed handlers' allow-lists omit includeDates and reject unknown parameters.
issues.statement: Documented requests using includeDates can receive HTTP 400.
issues.recommendation: Implement includeDates or remove it from those three tables.

issues.title: hasGeo default differs
issues.wikiEvidence: The data page states a default of all.
issues.sourceEvidence: The reviewed data handler defaults hasGeo to any.
issues.recommendation: Define and test the public semantic difference between any and all.

issues.title: Related-area includeNames parameter is undocumented
issues.wikiEvidence: The related, parents, children, siblings and similar sections omit includeNames.
issues.sourceEvidence: Each reviewed handler accepts includeNames and defaults it to true.
issues.statement: Clients cannot discover a useful payload-size and shape control from the wiki.
issues.recommendation: Document includeNames consistently for related-area operations.

issues.title: measure is listed but not explained
issues.wikiEvidence: measure appears in the data parameter table without a subsection.
issues.sourceEvidence: The reviewed handler accepts measure and defaults it to all.
issues.statement: Allowed values and interaction with indicator and status fields are not documented.
issues.recommendation: Add semantics, examples and a link to discover valid measure codes.

issues.title: Response and error contracts are incomplete
issues.wikiEvidence: The wiki provides examples and format descriptions but no complete schemas or common error model.
issues.sourceEvidence: Handlers return 400/404 responses and apply request-size validation.
issues.statement: Typed clients cannot be generated safely and agents cannot validate outputs rigorously.
issues.recommendation: Publish an upstream OpenAPI 3.1 contract with response schemas, errors, limits and examples.

issues.title: No compatibility or deprecation policy
issues.wikiEvidence: The wiki says the API may change without notice.
issues.statement: The v1 path does not itself establish stability.
issues.recommendation: Define ownership, change notification, versioning, deprecation and support expectations before external reuse.
